newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines said considering mortgage-backed debt.
newsitem.headline: Philippines said considering mortgage-backed debt.

text.p: A congressional leader said on Wednesday that the Philippines may start securitising housing mortgages by next year to meet the financing requirements of the housing industry.

House of Representatives Speaker Jose de Venecia told a forum of real estate developers that a discussion with President Fidel Ramos and government financial managers began six months ago to raise about 150 billion pesos through mortgage-backed debt.
"We need a combination of private sector funding, foreign investments, and congressional appropriations ... to beat the housing crisis," de Venecia said.
He did not disclose any other details about the plan.
The country has a backlog of 3.6 million low-cost housing units. - Manila newsroom 63 2 8418938 Fax 8176267
